title: serapias cordigera subsp. cossyrensis
intro: Serapias cordigera subsp. cossyrensis, commonly known as Sardinian Tongue Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Sardinia, Italy. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include a variety of health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Serapias cordigera subsp. cossyrensis include its use as a diuretic, and in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
